messages:
emma: quick heads up — console numbers for embeddings (chart: "prefetch units / day") don't match runtime counters after we enabled pre-aggregation last week. UI shows ~120k units, runtime says 45k. wondering if it's a telemetry backfill or double-counting from the splitter.
raj: ugh. do you have a query or sample spans?
emma: pasted the queries i used: 
```
-- console (rollup)
SELECT sum(estimate_units) FROM console_rollups WHERE service='embeddings' AND day='2026-03-20';
-- runtime (raw events)
SELECT sum(units) FROM runtime_events WHERE event='embed_request' AND day='2026-03-20';
```
notice console uses `estimate_units` (preagg) and runtime uses raw `units` events. preagg should be <= raw but it's >.
tj: that suggests either duplicate rollups (ingest job reprocessed) or events emitted both preagg and raw. did we enable both for a tenant-by-accident? @matt any recent changes to the splitter emitting telemetry?
matt: i tweaked the splitter to emit a light `preagg_hint` event for batching heuristics, but that code path emits `estimate_units` when debug flag on. i turned the flag on in canary and forgot to flip it off in the rollout.
sofia: ok so canary may have leaked. how did the console pipeline handle that? it should dedupe by request_id. maybe preagg events lack request_id?
raj: exactly — preagg events currently don't carry request_id (we emit aggregate per-window). dedupe needs request_id to be robust.
emma: UX problem: console shows tenants their billed estimate based on preagg rollups. customers will see wildly different numbers than billing (billing uses raw tokens). we need to either stop showing preagg in the billing view or annotate with sampling/explainers.
tj: short term: disable preagg ingestion for console on the canary timeframe and re-run rollup job to repair counts. long term: two paths — (1) enrich preagg events with request_id or deterministic hash; (2) change console to prefer raw-units when available and fall back to preagg only for older windows.
matt: i can flip the flag off now and re-ingest last 48h. is re-ingestion safe? it might double-count if rollups were already persisted.
emma: before doing that, we should snapshot current state and mark a DB migration window. i'll open a ticket.
sofia: also want a console change: show a little badge "units derived from pre-aggregated telemetry — may differ from billing" and add a tooltip with the query used and sampling rate. customers asked for transparency in last town hall. :eyes:
raj: agree. telemetry needs a versioned schema. i propose adding a header `X-Embed-Telemetry-Version: v2` and a `request_id` field on v2 preagg events. runtime can emit both v1 and v2 during rollout, console picks v2 when available.
tj: small nit: adding headers to runtime events is cheap but we need to ensure downstream storage can handle the extra cardinality. preagg keys blow up if we include unique request_id — but we only need request_id for dedupe during ingestion, not as a primary index. we can strip it post-dedupe.
matt: good call. i'll update the emitter to attach `request_id` and the ingestion job to dedupe then drop the field.
emma: for the console UX and rollout: can we add a toggle per-tenant to prefer raw vs preagg? ops + account teams might want control for early customers.
sofia: yes, add a `Telemetry preference` flag in tenant settings (dev: `telemetry_preference: raw|preagg|auto`). default auto picks raw when raw data exists for day.
raj: one more thing: quotas and routing. router currently uses `units` estimate from preagg for soft quotas which can under/over throttle. We need router to consult runtime token estimates (real-time) for throttle decisions. preagg only for dashboards.
tj: router changes are riskier. i'd prefer an incremental approach: set a grace window where router uses raw realtime counters if available; fallback to preagg with a penalty multiplier.
emma: sounds reasonable. action items: (1) matt flips canary flag off + stop emitting preagg hints (2) raj + tj sketch ingestion dedupe plan with `request_id` v2 (3) sofia implements console badge + tenant toggle + tooltip (4) raj to change router to prefer realtime for throttle decisions in a canary (5) emma will open ticket and coordinate stakeholders. i'll assign owners in the ticket.
matt: flipping now, will ping when done.
deploy-bot: canary-flip job started for service=embed-splitter, canary_id=canary-2026-03-20-14:22
matt: done — flag off in canary, canary logs show no `preagg_hint` after 14:24. i'll schedule re-ingest after we have the dedupe script ready.
sofia: i'll prototype the console badge this afternoon; quick mock here: https://redwood.internal/mockups/embed-telemetry-badge (mock, no prod).
raj: i'll PR ingestion dedupe plan — minimal: dedupe by `(tenant_id, day, request_id)` in the staging job. then drop request_id. CC @tj for router will.
tj: i'll run router sim against canary traffic to verify fallback behavior.
emma: perfect. thanks all — let's keep updates in this thread. i'll post ticket #ENG-4921 with timeline and follow-ups. :thumbsup:
